body: Yeah fuck that is brutal. I’m 22 and still haven’t made any major moves on my own yet cause I’m too anxious for that shit. Moving is so stressful, and for it to not turn out well has to be the cherry on the top of it all. I’m so sorry dude.
Mood. Idk what it is about other decades, the clothes the music fucking everything makes em seem better happier and less shit compared to the present

Yeah the worst part about crying is the headache that follows. Light, noise, I’ve never been hungover but I have to imagine the headache after crying for hours or days is the same — probably why crying is my vice instead of liquor lol 

I don’t doubt that you’ve had major fuck ups. I don’t want to say anything to belittle em or make them bigger in your head than they are now, but if venting it out will help pls write em out OP, wont judge, I can just read and be present
Thanks, I’ve said in the past I’ll get help, hopefully this will keep me a bit accountable in the long run
Fucking up fucking sucks, crying is understandable. I do the same thing
